name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx as a multi-site reverse proxy and web server for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, security hardening, Fail2ban, firewall, SSH restrictions, and development certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including service management, Redis authentication, log directory setup, and a post-generation configuration workaround.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python dependencies, PostgreSQL database and user provisioning, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
